_comment: G4.1 frozen fixture. Written before any judging. Truth for lif is the published layer at this manifest; for sif, the CEDS ID column SIF authors wrote. Scoring reads trueCardStableIdList; a judge never does. No two subjects share a source text.

lifSubjectList.name: name
lifSubjectList.definition: The name of a non-person entity such as an organization, institution, agency or business.

paraphrase.name: label
paraphrase.definition: The designation given to a non-individual body, including a company, school, government office or commercial enterprise.

lifSubjectList.name: shortName
lifSubjectList.definition: An abbreviated title for an assessment.

paraphrase.name: abbrevAssessmentLabel
paraphrase.definition: A condensed label used to refer to an evaluation.

lifSubjectList.name: startingRank
lifSubjectList.definition: The rank which the person held in the military service at the beginning of the service period.

paraphrase.name: initialMilitaryGrade
paraphrase.definition: The grade or position a individual had within the armed forces when their period of enlistment or duty first commenced.

lifSubjectList.name: addressCity
lifSubjectList.definition: The name of the city in which an address is located.

paraphrase.name: locality
paraphrase.definition: Name of the municipality where a given mailing location lies.

lifSubjectList.name: courseDepartmentName
lifSubjectList.definition: Department with jurisdiction over this course.

paraphrase.name: classOversightDivision
paraphrase.definition: The organizational unit that holds authority over this class.

lifSubjectList.name: contentStandardStatus
lifSubjectList.definition: A contentStandard status, which provide details about whether it is missing at will or not applicable.

paraphrase.name: curriculumBenchmarkState
paraphrase.definition: Indicator conveying whether a curriculum benchmark may be omitted by choice or does not apply.

lifSubjectList.name: birthInternationalProvince
lifSubjectList.definition: For students born outside of the U.S., the Province or jurisdiction in which an individual is born.

paraphrase.name: abroadBirthJurisdiction
paraphrase.definition: For learners whose birthplace lies beyond the United States, this records the province or other jurisdictional division where the person was born.

lifSubjectList.name: positionEmploymentStatus
lifSubjectList.definition: An indication of the employment status of an employee holding this position. For example, Volunteer, SelfEmployed, Employed, Freelancer, Intern, Contractor, or Other.

paraphrase.name: incumbentEngagementType
paraphrase.definition: Categorizes the nature of the working relationship held by whoever fills this role. Possible classifications include Intern, Freelancer, Other, Employed, Contractor, SelfEmployed, and Volunteer.

lifSubjectList.name: visa
lifSubjectList.definition: An indicator of a non-US citizen's Visa type.

paraphrase.name: immigrationStatusCode
paraphrase.definition: Designates the category of entry permit held by a student who is not a citizen of the United States.

lifSubjectList.name: deletedDate
lifSubjectList.definition: The date when the object with deleted.

paraphrase.name: removalDate
paraphrase.definition: Calendar day on which the entity was flagged as removed from the system.

lifSubjectList.name: name
lifSubjectList.definition: The descriptive name of a person's position.

paraphrase.name: designation
paraphrase.definition: A human-readable label describing the job a person fills.

lifSubjectList.name: identifier
lifSubjectList.definition: The primary key identifier for this entity data in the LIF data model. This value should uniquely identify this particular instance of the entity. The identifier can be created based on external identifiers, a newly created identifier unique to LIF, or a composite of other attributes related to the entity.

paraphrase.name: recordKey
paraphrase.definition: The main key used to tell each record of this entity apart within the LIF schema. Every instance must be distinguishable by this value. It may be assembled from outside codes, minted fresh for LIF, or built by combining several properties linked to the entity.

lifSubjectList.name: narrative
lifSubjectList.definition: A narrative that describes the evidence and process that led to an assertion of the credential.

paraphrase.name: rationale
paraphrase.definition: A written account of the proof and steps behind a credential being awarded.

lifSubjectList.name: hoursWorkedPerWeek
lifSubjectList.definition: The average number of hours anticipated by the employer to be worked in this postion per week.

paraphrase.name: avgWeeklyHoursExpected
paraphrase.definition: The mean weekly workload, in hours, that the hiring organization projects for this job role.

lifSubjectList.name: maximumDuration
lifSubjectList.definition: Maximum duration of time allowed in order to earn the credential.

paraphrase.name: maxTimeToComplete
paraphrase.definition: Longest period permitted for a learner to finish the requirements needed to obtain the certification.

lifSubjectList.name: fullTimeEquivalentRatio
lifSubjectList.definition: The number of total hours worked divided by the maximum number of compensable hours in a full-time schedule as defined by law, or determined by civil or organizational policies.

paraphrase.name: workloadFractionOfFullTime
paraphrase.definition: Quotient obtained by dividing aggregate hours actually performed by the ceiling of payable hours within a standard full-time timetable, where that ceiling is set either by legislation or by public-sector or institutional regulations.

lifSubjectList.name: purpose
lifSubjectList.definition: The reason for which an assessment is designed or delivered

paraphrase.name: assessment_objective
paraphrase.definition: The rationale behind why a test is created or administered.

lifSubjectList.name: goalSuccessCriteria
lifSubjectList.definition: One or more statements that describes the criteria used by teachers and students to check for attainment of a goal.

paraphrase.name: objectiveMeasureOfAchievement
paraphrase.definition: Any number of descriptions that specify the benchmarks educators and learners apply to confirm that a target has been reached.

lifSubjectList.name: informationSourceSystem
lifSubjectList.definition: The specific information system, application, or pipeline from which this entity data came. Examples include SIS, LMS, HR Systems, CRMs, and data warehouses. Typically, this value is configured in the orchestrator and applied to the LIF record as it is generated. This value may be visible to students, instructors, or staff via external applications or an LLM advisor, so it should be something easily identifiable. This field should help users identify which system to refer to if they have questions about the data associated with this field.

paraphrase.name: recordOriginSystem
paraphrase.definition: The particular software, application, or data pipeline that produced this record. Commonly cited sources include student information systems, learning management platforms, human resources software, customer relationship management tools, and data warehouses. An orchestrator usually sets this attribute and links it with the LIF record during creation. Students, teachers, or employees might see it through third-party tools or an AI assistant, so the label ought to be readily recognizable. It points people toward the correct source when they need clarification on the associated data.

lifSubjectList.name: addressCountyName
lifSubjectList.definition: The name of the county, parish, borough, or comparable unit (within a state) in which an address is located.

paraphrase.name: siteCountyTitle
paraphrase.definition: Designation for the administrative division inside a state, such as a county, parish, or borough, or an equivalent, that contains the given street location.

lifSubjectList.name: informationSourceId
lifSubjectList.definition: An identifier key that represents a combination of informationSourceOrganization and informationSourceSystem from which this entity data came. Typically, this value is configured in the orchestrator and applied to the LIF record as it is generated. This could be a human or machine-readable value.

paraphrase.name: dataOriginKey
paraphrase.definition: A lookup key pairing the organization and the system responsible for supplying this record's data. The orchestration component generally assigns it and attaches it while the record is being created. Its content may be readable by people or by machines.

lifSubjectList.name: revoked
lifSubjectList.definition: Indicates if the assertion of the credential has been revoked, thus invalidating the award.

paraphrase.name: isWithdrawn
paraphrase.definition: Flags whether the issuer has withdrawn the credential's claim, which renders the granted recognition no longer valid.

lifSubjectList.name: industryCode
lifSubjectList.definition: Numeric, and usually a NAICS code for industry for an employer (North American Industry Classification System).

paraphrase.name: sectorIdentifier
paraphrase.definition: Digits denoting the business sector in which an employing organization operates; most often drawn from the continental North American sector taxonomy.

lifSubjectList.name: employedWhileEnrolled
lifSubjectList.definition: An individual who is a paid employee or works in his or her own business, profession, or farm, as reported through the State Unemployment Insurance Wage Report, FEDES, or WRIS, and at the same time is enrolled in secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

paraphrase.name: workingWhileStudying
paraphrase.definition: Refers to a person who earns wages as an employee or operates their own enterprise, practice, or agricultural operation, documented via the state UI wage filing, FEDES, or WRIS, while also attending secondary, postsecondary, adult-schooling, or workforce training courses.

lifSubjectList.name: targetLearningResource
lifSubjectList.definition: Learning object or resource that is used as part of an learning activity.

paraphrase.name: aimedLearningMaterial
paraphrase.definition: A study item or material employed while carrying out an instructional task.

lifSubjectList.name: startDate
lifSubjectList.definition: Date the validity or usefulness of the information in this resource begins.

paraphrase.name: validFrom
paraphrase.definition: The calendar day on which the content of this record becomes applicable or relevant.

lifSubjectList.name: courseCreditLevelType
lifSubjectList.definition: The level of credit associated with the credit hours earned for the course.

paraphrase.name: courseCreditTierCategory
paraphrase.definition: Classification indicating the tier that applies to the academic units a learner receives upon completing this class.

lifSubjectList.name: birthVerification
lifSubjectList.definition: The evidence by which a child's date of birth is confirmed.

paraphrase.name: dobProofType
paraphrase.definition: The kind of documentation that substantiates a learner's recorded birth date.

lifSubjectList.name: normalTimeCompletionUnits
lifSubjectList.definition: The unit of measurement for length of time for completion.

paraphrase.name: standardDurationUnitOfMeasure
paraphrase.definition: The measurement unit used to express the expected elapsed time needed to finish the program under regular, non-accelerated conditions.

lifSubjectList.name: proofOfResidency
lifSubjectList.definition: An accepted form of proof of residency in the district/county/other locality.

paraphrase.name: domicileVerification
paraphrase.definition: A recognized type of document that may be submitted to demonstrate residence inside the district, county, or other local area.

lifSubjectList.name: livingRelationship
lifSubjectList.definition: Indicates whether or not the learner lives with the related person.

paraphrase.name: cohabitsWithContact
paraphrase.definition: States if the student resides in the same household as the associated individual, yes or no.

lifSubjectList.name: seekingAccreditationDate
lifSubjectList.definition: The date in which accreditation process was started (but not officially approved or denied).

paraphrase.name: accreditationReviewStartedOn
paraphrase.definition: The day on which an institution or program formally entered the accreditation review, before any final decision to grant or refuse recognition had been reached.

lifSubjectList.name: assessmentReportingMethod
lifSubjectList.definition: The method that the instructor of the course uses to report the performance and achievement of all persons. It may be a qualitative method such as individualized teacher comments or a quantitative method such as a letter or a numerical grade. In some cases, more than one type of reporting method may be used.

paraphrase.name: evaluationOutcomeFormat
paraphrase.definition: The style a course facilitator relies on to convey learners' results and proficiency. It can be descriptive, such as personalized narrative feedback, or numeric/symbolic, such as a letter mark or a score. Sometimes several such styles are combined.

lifSubjectList.name: identifierVerification
lifSubjectList.definition: The evidence by which a persons name, address, date of birth, etc. is confirmed.

paraphrase.name: identityProofing
paraphrase.definition: The documentation or check used to validate a person's legal name, residential location, birth date, and similar personal attributes.

lifSubjectList.name: informationSourceOrganization
lifSubjectList.definition: The organization from which this entity data came, such as a school, college, employer, agency, or vendor. Typically, this value is configured in the orchestrator and applied to the LIF record as it is generated. This could be the organization’s name or another preferred way to indicate the organization. This value may be visible to students or instructors via external applications or an LLM advisor, so it should be something easily identifiable. This field should help users identify which system to refer to if they have questions about the data associated with this field.

paraphrase.name: originatingBodyLabel
paraphrase.definition: Name of the institution or entity that supplied a given record, such as a school, university, company, government office, or supplier. The orchestrator usually sets this value as the record is produced. It may be the formal name or an alternate label chosen for clarity. Because students and teachers can see it in outside tools or an AI assistant, it should be recognizable at a glance. It directs people to the right system when they need clarification about the record's contents.

lifSubjectList.name: ctdlOrganizationType
lifSubjectList.definition: The type of credentialing organization or entity as defined by the Credential Transparency Description Language.

paraphrase.name: credentialingBodyCategory
paraphrase.definition: Classification applied to an organization or body that issues or manages credentials, drawn from the value set of the CTDL vocabulary.

lifSubjectList.name: shortName
lifSubjectList.definition: The name of the institution, which may be the abbreviated form of the full legally accepted name.

paraphrase.name: condensedInstitutionLabel
paraphrase.definition: A brief label for an organization, which can be a contracted version of its officially recognized complete title.

lifSubjectList.name: performanceLowerLevel
lifSubjectList.definition: Lowest possible score for the performance level.

paraphrase.name: achievementBandMinimum
paraphrase.definition: The smallest value a score can hold while still falling within this achievement tier.

lifSubjectList.name: highestLevelEducation
lifSubjectList.definition: The extent of formal instruction a person has received (e.g., the highest grade in school completed or its equivalent or the highest degree received).

paraphrase.name: peakSchoolingLevel
paraphrase.definition: The degree of academic training an individual has finished, such as the last school year passed, a comparable standing, or the top academic credential earned.

lifSubjectList.name: courseSectionExitWithdrawalDate
lifSubjectList.definition: The year, month and day of the first day after the date of a person's last enrollment in a course section.

paraphrase.name: classSectionDepartureDate
paraphrase.definition: Calendar date falling on the day immediately after a learner's final registration in a class section.

lifSubjectList.name: courseGradeStatusCode
lifSubjectList.definition: Additional information regarding the context of the given grade.

paraphrase.name: courseMarkConditionCode
paraphrase.definition: Supplementary detail describing the circumstances surrounding the assigned mark.

lifSubjectList.name: qualifyingMoveCity
lifSubjectList.definition: The name of the city in which the child resided prior to the qualifying move.

paraphrase.name: eligibilityMoveOriginTown
paraphrase.definition: Municipality where the learner was living before the relocation that made them eligible.

lifSubjectList.name: branch
lifSubjectList.definition: A branch of the U.S. Military applicable for specifying more details when using Military Connected Student Indicator, Military Active Student Indicator, Military Veteran Student Indicator, and Military Enlistment After Exit elements.

paraphrase.name: service
paraphrase.definition: Which U.S. armed service a learner is tied to, adding specificity to the flags that mark a student as military-connected, currently serving, a former service member, or enlisting after leaving school.

lifSubjectList.name: estimatedDuration
lifSubjectList.definition: Estimated time it will take to complete a program. [=>DurationProfile]

paraphrase.name: projectedTimeToComplete
paraphrase.definition: Forecast amount of time required for a program to be finished. Linked to the DurationProfile entity.

lifSubjectList.name: lastName
lifSubjectList.definition: The last name of a person or individual

paraphrase.name: surname
paraphrase.definition: Family name belonging to a human being.

lifSubjectList.name: humanCode
lifSubjectList.definition: A human-readable, locally unique string identifier of the Credential.

paraphrase.name: readableLabel
paraphrase.definition: A text tag for a qualification that people can easily read, and which is unique within the originating system.

lifSubjectList.name: recognizedBy
lifSubjectList.definition: Agent that acknowledges the validity of the program.

paraphrase.name: validatedBy
paraphrase.definition: Party that affirms that this program is legitimate.

lifSubjectList.name: provider
lifSubjectList.definition: Identifies the provider or publisher of the assessment.

paraphrase.name: vendor
paraphrase.definition: Names the organization that supplies or releases the evaluation.

lifSubjectList.name: publicationDate
lifSubjectList.definition: The date on which this content was first published.

paraphrase.name: releaseDate
paraphrase.definition: The calendar day when this material first became available to the public.

lifSubjectList.name: contractLength
lifSubjectList.definition: The contracted period for the person.

paraphrase.name: engagementDuration
paraphrase.definition: The span of time covered by an individual's employment agreement.

sifSubjectList.name: ProgressLevel
sifSubjectList.definition: The amount of progress shown in academic subjects.

paraphrase.name: AchievementStage
paraphrase.definition: The degree of advancement a learner has reached within their coursework.

sifSubjectList.name: explanation
sifSubjectList.definition: Description of the changes made to the individualized program service plan.

paraphrase.name: elaboration
paraphrase.definition: Written account of amendments introduced into the personalized service scheme.

sifSubjectList.name: MiddleName
sifSubjectList.definition: The middle name or initial.

paraphrase.name: SecondGivenName
paraphrase.definition: A person's additional given name or its abbreviated letter, placed between the first given name and the family name.

sifSubjectList.name: responsibleSchoolType
sifSubjectList.definition: The type of services/instruction the school is responsible for providing to the student.

paraphrase.name: accountableSchoolCategory
paraphrase.definition: Category of educational support or teaching that a learner's school is accountable for delivering to that learner.

sifSubjectList.name: CourseCreditsEarned
sifSubjectList.definition: Number of course credits earned.

paraphrase.name: EarnedCourseCredit
paraphrase.definition: Total count of credits a student has accrued from completed courses.

sifSubjectList.name: countryCode
sifSubjectList.definition: The unique two character International Organization for Standardization (ISO) code for the country in which an address is located.

paraphrase.name: nationCode
paraphrase.definition: A two-letter identifier drawn from the ISO country list, specifying the nation where a given postal location lies.

sifSubjectList.name: Code
sifSubjectList.definition: Code representing the grade level.

paraphrase.name: GradeLevelIndicator
paraphrase.definition: Symbol that identifies a student's year or tier of schooling.

sifSubjectList.name: primaryIndicator
sifSubjectList.definition: An indication that the telephone number should be used as the principal number for a person or organization.

paraphrase.name: mainContactFlag
paraphrase.definition: A marker showing that this phone number is the one to dial first when reaching an individual or an institution.

sifSubjectList.name: emergencyContactIndicator
sifSubjectList.definition: Indicates whether or not the person is a designated emergency contact for the learner.

paraphrase.name: pupilUrgentContactFlag
paraphrase.definition: States yes or no: has this individual been formally named as a go-to contact to be reached in urgent situations involving the student.

sifSubjectList.name: parentConcernDescription
sifSubjectList.definition: Parent's explanation of their interest in student's participation in special education

paraphrase.name: caregiverConcernNarrative
paraphrase.definition: A guardian's narrative clarifying why they are invested in the pupil's engagement within special education.

sifSubjectList.name: nonInclusionMinutesPerWeek
sifSubjectList.definition: The number of minutes per week that a student with disabilities is served in a regular classroom with his or her non-disabled peers.

paraphrase.name: weeklyMainstreamClassMinutes
paraphrase.definition: Weekly duration, in minutes, that a learner with a disability spends in a standard classroom together with classmates who do not have disabilities.

sifSubjectList.name: category
sifSubjectList.definition: Legal category for an IEP annual goal or short-term objectives.

paraphrase.name: classification
paraphrase.definition: Statutory grouping that determines how an Individualized Education Program's yearly target or interim benchmarks are classed.

sifSubjectList.name: line2
sifSubjectList.definition: The second line of the address.

paraphrase.name: addrseg2
paraphrase.definition: Supplementary row of a postal location block, positioned immediately after the first row.

sifSubjectList.name: StateProvince
sifSubjectList.definition: The state or province code.

paraphrase.name: RegionCode
paraphrase.definition: Abbreviated designation identifying the administrative subdivision of a country, such as a state or province.

sifSubjectList.name: lifecyclePurpose
sifSubjectList.definition: Purpose within the IEP lifecycle for which the eligibility evaluation is conducted.

paraphrase.name: iepPhaseObjective
paraphrase.definition: The reason, within the stage of an Individualized Education Program process, that motivates carrying out the eligibility assessment.

sifSubjectList.name: code
sifSubjectList.definition: The code for the specific language or dialect that a person uses to communicate.

paraphrase.name: langIdentifier
paraphrase.definition: The identifier assigned to the particular tongue or regional variety through which an individual conveys meaning.

sifSubjectList.name: LastName
sifSubjectList.definition: The last name.

paraphrase.name: FamilyName
paraphrase.definition: The surname of the individual.

sifSubjectList.name: type
sifSubjectList.definition: The specific accommodation necessary for assessment or instruction.

paraphrase.name: kind
paraphrase.definition: The particular adjustment required to support testing or teaching.

sifSubjectList.name: NeglectedOrDelinquentProgramType
sifSubjectList.definition: The year, month and day on which the person began to participate in a program.The type of program under ESEA Title I, Part D, Subpart 1 (state programs) or Subpart 2 (LEA).

paraphrase.name: NeglectedOrDelinquentSchemeKind
paraphrase.definition: Calendar date (year, month, and day) when the individual first took part in the scheme. Classification of the scheme under the federal statute's neglected-and-delinquent provisions: the state-administered variant (Subpart 1) or the district-administered variant (Subpart 2).

sifSubjectList.name: classEndingTime
sifSubjectList.definition: An indication of the time of day the class ends.

paraphrase.name: sessionFinishClock
paraphrase.definition: The clock time at which a scheduled instructional session concludes each day.

sifSubjectList.name: CTEGraduationRateInclusion
sifSubjectList.definition: An indication of how CTE concentrators are included in the state's computation of its graduation rate.

paraphrase.name: CareerTechGradRateCountingIndicator
paraphrase.definition: A marker showing the manner in which career and technical education concentrators are counted within the state's calculation of graduation rates.

sifSubjectList.name: givenName
sifSubjectList.definition: The full legal first name given to a person at birth, baptism, or through legal change.

paraphrase.name: forenameLegal
paraphrase.definition: The complete, officially recorded forename assigned to an individual at birth or baptism, or subsequently altered through a legal procedure.

sifSubjectList.name: Code
sifSubjectList.definition: Identifies the specific accommodation.  At least one required if the repeating group is sent.

paraphrase.name: Designator
paraphrase.definition: Names the particular accommodation in question. A minimum of one occurrence must be included whenever the enclosing repetition set is transmitted.

sifSubjectList.name: explanation
sifSubjectList.definition: Description of the reason changes were made to the individualized program service plan.

paraphrase.name: rationale_for_iep_amendment
paraphrase.definition: Narrative stating why modifications were introduced into the student's individualized education program or service agreement.

sifSubjectList.name: @Type
sifSubjectList.definition: The type of credit.

paraphrase.name: @CreditCategory
paraphrase.definition: Classifies the credit by its kind.

sifSubjectList.name: postalCode
sifSubjectList.definition: A number that identifies each postal delivery area in the locale used as a portion of an address.

paraphrase.name: zipCode
paraphrase.definition: A numeric value assigned to a mail-sorting region within a country, forming part of a street address.

sifSubjectList.name: DaysAbsent
sifSubjectList.definition: Number of days absent.

paraphrase.name: AbsenceDayCount
paraphrase.definition: Total count of school days on which the student was not present.

sifSubjectList.name: HighSchoolGraduationRateIndicatorStatus
sifSubjectList.definition: An indication of whether the school or district met the High School Graduation Rate requirement in accordance with state definition for the purposes of determining AYP.

paraphrase.name: SecondaryCompletionBenchmarkOutcome
paraphrase.definition: Shows whether a campus or local education agency reached the secondary diploma-attainment threshold as the state defines it, used to decide AYP.

sifSubjectList.name: @Type
sifSubjectList.definition: Code that specifies what type of phone number this is.  Note: A subset of valid values may be specified in data objects.

paraphrase.name: @PhoneCategory
paraphrase.definition: Coded value denoting the category of a telephone number. Certain data objects may limit this to a smaller set of acceptable entries.

sifSubjectList.name: Code
sifSubjectList.definition: Code representing the language of instruction.

paraphrase.name: InstructionLanguageIdentifier
paraphrase.definition: Identifier denoting the tongue in which teaching is delivered.

paraphraseUsdNote: an upper bound: priced at the Opus row of spendPricing.ini. This model is cheaper, and its own row is not in that table.
